Fence Operation mutations after cancellation

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: fewensa-43
  description: |-
    Serialize ordinary current-Operation mutations against their parent Attempt before locking the Operation. Reject new mutations after a durable requested cancellation while preserving completed command replay semantics.
    
    Add PostgreSQL lock-gated coverage for completion-first and cancel-first races with and without Dispatch authority. Align the maintained Picker specification and OpenWiki lifecycle table with the cancelling state, durable receipts, fencing semantics, and guarded rollback constraint.
